description: Remove an account's access to a specific instance (by id or exact name) entirely, revoking every permission they had. They lose access the moment this succeeds. Call list_instance_users first to confirm who you are removing; the owner cannot be removed. To take away only some permissions, use set_user_permissions instead.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be removed (the user loses all access to this server immediately) and getting their approval.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

user.description: Account id, or an exact username of 3+ characters to look up.

name: remove_user_access
title: Remove User Access
